verdict.rationale: LiveKit ships official first-party Agents SDKs in Python and Node.js, with step-by-step guides for building agents in code. A CLI complements them for accessing server APIs, creating tokens, and scaffolding and deploying agents. Missing for 10: per-language SDK reference documentation and an enumerated list of client/mobile SDKs in the evidence, plus independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality (one user wished for a Rust desktop SDK).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Build a simple voice agent with Python or Node.js in less than 10 minutes.
Build a voice agent in code with this step-by-step guide.
